changes.from: Rename: maker brands itself NineRay (九光/Jiuguang), HQ Hong Kong. Unveiled Aug 17, 2026; sales from Sept 2026. Payload is 30 kg dual-hand operation (100 kg deadlift, 60 kg dual-arm hold). ~US$200k price is press-reported only, left out.
changes.to: Maker brands itself NineRay (NineRay Technology, 九光/Jiuguang; earlier recorded as 'Ninray'), HQ Hong Kong. Unveiled Aug 17, 2026; sales from Sept 2026. Payload is 30 kg dual-hand operation (100 kg deadlift, 60 kg dual-arm hold). ~US$200k price is press-reported only, left out.
